PACKET. work/records/2026/11/finding-v12-worker-declared-failure-status/evidence/correction-K-20261121/ (HANDOFF.md 955abca2…, manifest.json, base/, candidate/, candidate.sha256, correction-from-native.patch, logs/, probes/, umask-runs/, narrative-current.sha256, evidence.sha256 58293e47…, 47 entries). Starting bytes: native listing e686d8c2… (10 paths over 7ac02c7f, head 4c528624…), re-verified path by path. Changed: 3 paths — src/baton_v12/worker_manager/failure_cause.py (05f49b4a… → bcd53370…), tests/manager/test_attempt_failure_cause.py (62b690e9… → 093db1a8…), tests/tools/test_job_observation.py (813d9a37… → f1aa0b8b…); the other 7 byte-identical. New 10-path listing 10f3d809254c3da937b4dc0761c9ec5971ea55ec2c0ed1fe6b21d50d3511eae0; patch fb31d571… (186 lines; reproduces the corrected tree from the native bytes, verified).

R1 (bounded open). `_bound_bytes` opens the retained result with O_NONBLOCK beside O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC; the type is judged on the opened descriptor (fstat, S_ISREG), size and measured digest still bind, symlinks still refused, identity/manifest binding unchanged. A FIFO where the regular file was measured now returns at once as "not a regular file"; a regular file reads exactly as before.

R2 (absent ≠ null). `_declared_members` reads verification through a sentinel: no member → attempted and status both unknown ("carries no verification member, so whether a command ran is unknown"); explicit null → not attempted (status unknown) as before; document → attempted, status owned only inside EXIT_STATUS_RANGE; anything else → both unknown. Other members, sealed disposition, cause/revocation/cancellation axes and lifecycle separation untouched; the renderers already say "whether verification ran is unknown" for an unknown axis — no renderer change.

PROOF. New public-path cases in TheWorkerDeclaredAxisIsComposedFromSEALEDEVIDENCE: FIFO replacement → attempt_failure_cause_of returns promptly (5 s watchdog never fires), every typed member unknown with the "does not recompute" reason, disposition/result_id known, cause axis unmoved; missing member → both axes unknown, other members still stand; explicit null → not attempted; status 0 → known; malformed ("ran", 7, [], {"status":"one"}, {"status":2**40}) → status unknown. Rendering case in test_job_observation: unknown axis → "whether verification ran is unknown" in status/list/detail, never "not attempted". Class 20/20, module 39/39 (logs/declared-axis-2.log). Reviewer's own probe.py rerun on the corrected tree (byte-copied; 10 s limit): fifo returns in 0.4 s (was killed at 3 s); missing-verification → [false,null]/[false,null] (was [true,false]); nested-json unchanged. Required four-module coverage with the overlay named separately: run_focused.py selection (minus the two deep cases) on the corrected tree WITHOUT overlay Ran 271 OK (266 + 5 new; Git rejected), and on the overlay tree Ran 271 OK; the two deep cases on the overlay tree (W385454 c6755437…/03a7710e…, accepted M385461; not part of this candidate) under the established confinement: umask 077 2/2 OK (posture 0o730), umask 022 2/2 OK (0o775); 442 confined Git invocations each, 0 refused, none outside the fixture roots. Overlay verification, not pristine-native; the native exit 1 remains historical.

HONEST ACCOUNTING. logs/declared-axis-1.log: first run of the new cases failed on two test-side errors (FIFO case on a worker thread vs the store's thread binding; malformed case expected -1 outside EXIT_STATUS_RANGE) — tests corrected, product correction unchanged. logs/stale/: first overlay runs made before the overlay copy was re-synced with the final test files (a packaging slip of mine; 270 tests, 1F/1E from stale test bytes), retained, superseded by the re-synced runs. narrative-current.sha256 supplies the current RECOVERY.md digest (7023f42d…) beside the stale entry the review noted, which is left as recorded.

BOUNDARIES. No W385427/W385454 composition, host import, live-instance access, or Git mutation outside the fresh confined fixture roots under /var/tmp/baton-v12-w385424-fix/. FINDING.md/PLAN.md of this dossier updated. Handoff: independent delta review of the three-path delta; then serial composition of the three deltas with joined review before any host import and human checkpoint. Cross-reference on T321608.
